listing.title: My First Bugs & Butterflies Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Bug Pages – Butterfly, Ladybug, Bee, Caterpillar & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly bugs!

Little hands color 30 smiling bugs and garden friends, from a butterfly and a ladybug to a buzzing bumblebee, a caterpillar and a snail. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • Bugs and crawly friends: Butterfly, Ladybug, Bumblebee, Caterpillar, Snail, Ant, Dragonfly, Firefly, Grasshopper, Beetle, Spider, Worm, Moth, Cricket, Praying Mantis, Stick Insect and Roly-Poly
  • From the garden: Chrysalis, Beehive, Honey Jar, Anthill, Daisy, Sunflower, Tulip, Leaf and Mushroom
  • For little bug explorers: Bug Jar, Magnifying Glass, Butterfly Net and Watering Can
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
